verdict: At cadence C, with each input the specifications bound at its favourable end (C 0.846 F, window 4.979→3.203 V, the plateau-top (0.90 at any input) boost curve, wake 28.8 mJ, no leak, the high reflected reading), the node cannot ride 1991–2020 below 0.00427 cm² under the closed stand (beam through the gaps, face 180) — below the whole desk bracket 0.0439–0.1918 cm² — and below 0.00427 cm² in the open (face 180) — below the whole desk bracket 0.2092–0.3487 cm². With each at its adverse end (C 0.263 F, window 4.665→3.420 V, the least efficient boost curve, wake 43.2 mJ, §9.3's 4.5 µW leak illustration, the low reflected reading): below 0.103 cm² closed (all faces and both forms equal — a diffuse-only binding stretch) — inside the bracket — and 0.103 cm² open — below the whole bracket. The Standby sleep alone, favourable end: below 0.00109 cm² closed. Which closed-stand form describes a closed stand is not established, so each sentence takes the lower. Necessary conditions only.

measured_form_r.leg: 00_07 HW.54 Р3(б)(4) — the R threshold before the data
measured_form_r.form: G = R·GHI, A_eff = η·A — R holds the canopy's T, the face's geometry and its horizon; the harvest depends on η·A·R alone, so R* = A_eff*(GHI) / (η·A) at any η
measured_form_r.dome_face_is: the OUTER dome face — an upper bound on a cell's area; the cell sits inside behind a window
measured_form_r.r_bound_is: ½(1 + ρ) of the open horizontal for an unshaded vertical under an isotropic sky, on 79's two bare-ground readings — the adverse binding stretch carries no beam; an overcast sky gives the face less, a canopy less still
measured_form_r.eta_pv_readings_are: a-Si's low end · a good c-Si cell's top at weak daylight (01_03 §4 ⊕ (3)) — readings, no cell picked
measured_form_r.rounding: R* and A_eff lower ends rounded DOWN (a «below it cannot» sentence), upper ends UP
measured_form_r.not_seen: R moving with the day, the sky, the ground or the season — R is taken constant, while the sheet measures December–February (the lanes in binding_stretch_last_full_in_november bind from November) and a snowy winter's R carries snow light the bare-ground binding stretches lack; the reference is the yard's open horizontal, not ERA5's cell; the instrument's spectral weighting (a silicon pyranometer — about a c-Si cell's; under a NIR-shifted canopy an a-Si cell's R would be lower, so the measured R is biased high for it — the shift's sign rests on an abstract the sheet has not verified); η 8 % on rows whose R is a few per cent of open light, where the bracket's source gives a c-Si cell at most 5 %
measured_form_r.necessary_only: the leg asked for the R at which a reading PASSES; this publishes the R below which it CANNOT — the same number to the bracket, read as a necessary condition (in-silico §When Modifying #50)

verdict_measured_form: Read in the measured form — the light on the dome's face as R·GHI, R the field sheet's ratio of a vertical stem face to an open horizontal, with the canopy and the face's geometry inside it — and a cell of efficiency η on the outer dome face (6.975 cm² — an upper bound: a cell sits inside behind a window, and the flat crown is Ø19.8 mm, 3.08 cm², before any glue land; a smaller cell raises each R in inverse proportion to its area), at cadence C the node cannot ride 1991–2020 below R 0.0218 at η 3 % ⊥ 0.00818 at η 8 % on the favourable corner; the nominal one needs 0.0358 at η 3 % ⊥ 0.0134 at η 8 %, the adverse 0.291 at η 3 % ⊥ 0.109 at η 8 %. R is taken constant over the record. Necessary conditions only.
